description.p: Subtitld times subtitles on the audio's waveform and shows them over the video as they will be seen. It transcribes speech into timed subtitles, translates them, and dubs them with synthetic voices, one for each speaker.

ul.li: Move and retime subtitles on the waveform, snapping to their neighbours or to a grid of frames
Work down the subtitles on a vertical timeline beside the list
Give each speaker a face, a colour and a track of their own
Check reading speed, duration and line length as you go
Keep translations beside the original, in the list and on the timeline
Mix the video's sound and the dubs, with EQ, compressor and gate per track
Export the dub as WAV, FLAC or MP3, mixed or a track per speaker
Open and save SRT, WebVTT, TTML, SAMI, SCC and more

description.p: Speech recognition, offline translation and more voices, voice cloning among them, come as add-ons installed from inside Subtitld. Many of them run fully offline.
